flags.text: Latest wholesale month (Sep 2026) is preliminary (速報) and thin: 53,814 t traded.
Wholesale monthly data starts Sep 2010 (missing 2009 crop); all models use Sep 2010 onward.
e-Stat retail prices before Jan 2002 are per 10 kg (outside the window).
Tax: prices shown with tax are as published; 'without tax' divides by 1.05 before Apr 2014 and 1.08 after.
